_comment: Verbatim excerpt of two recorded Agent 1 IR runs for NCT01243424 (CAROLINA), taken from data/cache/agent1_ir/ (gitignored, so the rules are vendored here). Both runs saw the SAME numbered protocol line and disagreed on how many criteria it yields: three (ALT, AST, ALP) in one run, one in the other. Nothing else in the pair distinguishes them, which is what makes this a line-to-criterion cardinality fixture rather than a clinical one.

exclusionRules.source_text: 1. Active liver disease or impaired hepatic function, defined by serum levels of either ALT (SGPT), AST (SGOT), or alkaline phosphatase above 3 x upper limit of normal (ULN) as determined at visit 1a
